comments: PREP Accessibility Checker is part of Continual Engine's PREP document accessibility platform and is also available through an API for automated, high-volume accessibility validation. It evaluates PDF documents against WCAG 2.2AA and PDF/UA requirements and generates structured accessibility results and reports. This submission relates specifically to PREP's accessibility evaluation functionality.
features: PREP PDF Accessibility Checker evaluates PDFs against ISO 14289-1 (PDF/UA) using the Matterhorn Protocol and WCAG 2.2AA. It automatically identifies accessibility issues and provides structured results, accessibility scores, pass/fail outcomes, and detailed reports to support accessibility review and remediation.
title: PREP PDF Accessibility Checker
